description: Request a CSV export of Brevo contacts (POST /contacts/export). Required: customContactFilter (e.g. { actionForContacts: 'allContacts' } or { listId, actionForContacts }). Optional: exportAttributes (array), notifyUrl. Returns a process id; get_brevo_process gives the download URL.

customContactFilter.description: Which contacts to export, e.g. { actionForContacts: 'allContacts' } or { listId, actionForContacts }

exportAttributes.description: Contact attributes to include in the CSV

notifyUrl.description: URL notified when the export is ready

name: export_brevo_contacts
